title: Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Cancellation and No-Show Fee Table
content:
Each Bluegate Moving Truck Rental class carries a free cancellation window — the elapsed hours before the scheduled pickup time up to which a cancellation is free — together with its flat late cancellation fee figure (the class figure for a cancellation made inside that window), the elapsed hours after the scheduled pickup time at which an unclaimed reservation becomes a no-show, and the no-show fee.

| Vehicle class | Free cancellation up to (elapsed hours before scheduled pickup) | Flat late cancellation fee figure (USD) | No-show after (elapsed hours after scheduled pickup) | No-show fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Pickup Truck | 24 | 25.00 | 2 | 50.00 |
| Bluegate Cargo Van | 24 | 25.00 | 2 | 50.00 |
| Bluegate 10 ft Moving Truck | 24 | 25.00 | 2 | 50.00 |
| Bluegate 15 ft Moving Truck | 24 | 25.00 | 2 | 50.00 |
| Bluegate 20 ft Moving Truck | 48 | 50.00 | 2 | 75.00 |
| Bluegate 26 ft Moving Truck | 48 | 50.00 | 2 | 75.00 |

## Points of reading

- The two largest classes, the Bluegate 20 ft Moving Truck and the Bluegate 26 ft Moving Truck, have a 48-hour free cancellation window, a 50.00 late cancellation fee figure and a 75.00 no-show fee; the four smaller classes have 24 hours, 25.00 and 50.00.
- The no-show point is 2 elapsed hours after the scheduled pickup time on every class.
- All hour figures in this table are elapsed hours measured from the scheduled pickup date and time.
